test_title: PYST 24: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: From a square with area a² another square made on mid points of the sides of the square is removed. What is the area left in the square?
solution:
**Given:**

Area of outer square = a²

**Formula Used:**

Area of square = (side)²

Area of triangle = 1/2 × base × height

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65bc14ac174128bc3f92e608ba2e04b841f36628a4a0fa4fcba85fa6072198f8.png] 

Side of outer square = a

Midpoints form a smaller square.

Triangles at corners are right-angled with sides a/2.

Area of 1 triangle = 1/2 × a/2 × a/2 = a²/8

Area of 4 triangles = 4 × a²/8 = a²/2

Area left = Area of outer square - Area of 4 triangles

⇒ Area left = a² - a²/2

⇒ Area left = a²/2

**∴ The area left in the square is a²/2.**
